observations.why: Settled declarative adoption statement — confident but low-arousal, no intensifiers or energized markers.
Quantitative superlative carries energized enthusiasm for the performance gain — high-arousal positive valence.
Forward-looking timeline stated in neutral register — settled confidence, low arousal, positive valence toward the plan.
Summary recap of the performance gain in a structured list — the magnitude is positive but the bullet format dampens arousal to settled satisfaction.

mints.name: QuantifiedPerformanceEnthusiasm
mints.title: energized enthusiasm expressed through quantitative performance magnitudes
mints.frame: Is the speaker's positive arousal carried by a numeric performance claim rather than by explicit affective language?
